name: Call for Iron Man! - War Machine
description_md: - ### _1st-Turn [Iron Man](/card/23002) with [Call for Aid](/card/12015) into [Shoulder Cannon](/card/23007) -- smells like napalm in the morning!_ ___ ### _**Theme:**_ - The purpose of this deck is to use [Call for Aid](/card/12015) to tutor [Iron Man](/card/23002) (he's the only Avenger in the deck), thus getting your [Shoulder Cannon](/card/23007) up and running along with the rest of his kit as quickly as possible. - I like that it's also thematic as he teams up with his buddy, Iron Man (who ironically is on the art for [Call for Aid](/card/12015)). Use [Iron Man](/card/23002)'s 'enter play' ability with [Rapid Response](/card/08031) and through tutoring to build your kit ASAP. ### **_[Call for Aid](/card/12015) = [Iron Man](/card/01029a):_** - You essentially have [Iron Man](/card/23002) x4 and with [Call for Aid](/card/12015) you will automatically tutor him every time because he's the only Avenger in the deck. - That means with this deck you'll usually get first turn [Iron Man](/card/23002) -- and [Two Against the World](/card/23024) Turn 1 or Turn 2 more often than you'd think. - Of course when you get [Iron Man](/card/23002) you'll tutor [Shoulder Cannon](/card/23007). - You'll also thin your deck and put [Munitions Bunker](/card/23003) and War Machine’s other cards back into a thinned deck so you'll draw them within a few turns. - If [Iron Man](/card/23002) dies, you can easily get him back in again with [Rapid Response](/card/08031) or by tutoring with [Call for Aid](/card/12015) after you put him back in your deck with your alter-ego ability. This way you can lay down your War Machine upgrades as quickly as possible. - This deck takes a few games to get how it works and it's pretty aggressive, but I've had a lot of fun with it! ### _**Leadership?**_ - We've seen a lot of good War Machine deck options, but I haven't seen a Leadership aspect deck yet, so I thought I would share since it has a unique idea. I've cleared several campaigns with it now (in solo on Expert, something that War Machine has trouble with), so it is viable, and lots of fun. _____ ### ***Hope you have as much fun with this deck as I do! My latest decks:*** - [Wild Tutor - Adam Warlock](https://marvelcdb.com/decklist/view/13922/wild-tutor-adam-warlock-1.0) - [Red Rambo - Spectrum / Aggression](https://marvelcdb.com/decklist/view/13617/red-fist-rambeau-spectrum-aggression-1.0) ______
